purpose: Teach: 潮流/産み/就学/幕末/細川/秀吉/道筋/偽り

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、時代の潮流に乗れ
lines.en: We need to move with the times.
lines.style: Authoritative and measured. Sharp attack on the opening. Deliberate pace. The tone of someone laying down principle, not negotiating it. Final word lands with quiet finality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新サービスを産み出す体制を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll put together a structure to develop new services.
lines.style: Crisp, professional acknowledgment. Lean forward slightly on the commitment. Steady, reliable tempo. No flourish—just competence being stated plainly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員のお子様の就学を支援しろ
lines.en: Support educational expenses for our employees' children.
lines.style: Directive and clear. No softening. Each clause distinct and weighted. Tone is matter-of-fact, not harsh—this is simply how things will be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。幕末創業の老舗と提携いたします
lines.en: Understood. We'll partner with an established firm from the Bakumatsu era.
lines.style: Confirmation with specificity. Slight breath before naming the detail. Shows the groundwork is already underway. Steady, confident delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、細川家系の文化財寄贈にも協力しろ
lines.en: We'll also support donations of cultural assets from the Hosokawa family.
lines.style: Same directorial weight as the earlier directives. Calm, expansive scope. The phrasing suggests this is part of a larger vision being articulated. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。秀吉時代の城下町イベントにも協賛します
lines.en: Understood. We'll sponsor the Hideyoshi-era castle town events as well.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, then the scope broadens. Slight lift in the voice on 'as well'—showing this integrates seamlessly into the larger strategy. Composed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界での道筋を見極めろ
lines.en: Know where the industry is headed.
lines.style: Shorter, sharper than the previous directives. Cutting to essence. Measured but urgent. The tone of experience reading the market. Lands with intent.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。誇大広告や偽り表記は絶対に許しません
lines.en: Understood. We will absolutely never allow misleading advertising or false claims.
lines.style: Final statement carries conviction and closure. Slight emphasis on 'absolutely never.' Steady throughout. This is not a promise—it's a principle. Voice settles with finality.
